taylor: quick heads-up — saw big perf hit on amd pool for longer sequences. seq_len=1536 requests are picking CPU kernels (fallback) instead of any ROCm kernels. ~2.4x token latency increase.

nishant: can you paste the runtime log snippet? also which gfx arch?

taylor: log:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z runtime INFO selected_kernel=cpu_attention reason=missing_kernel(name=rocm_fused_attn_fp16, arch=gfx1030)
model=redwood-7b seq_len=1536 batch=1
latency_per_token_ms=85.2 baseline_ms=35.0
```

mia: :face_with_monocle: hmm. looks like the autotuner didn't register any rocm kernels for seq>1024 on gfx1030. Could be our kernel discovery filter (opset/seq_bucket) or packaging omission.

sam: KV cache behavior might be amplifying this — longer context increases KV storage and triggers a fallback path if memory estimates don't match kernel footprints. Did the request include `use_kv_cache=true`? Any evictions?

taylor: yes use_kv_cache=true, no evictions in logs. `rocm-smi` shows ~70% GPU mem used before fallback.

nishant: provisional triage:
- confirm kernel registry entries for gfx1030 (search for `fused_attn_fp16_gfx1030`)
- run small perf probe: `./bin/runtime --probe-kernels --arch gfx1030 --seq 1536`
- rerun autotuner for seq brackets [128, 512, 1024, 1536]

mia: quick mitigation: adjust conditional routing to prefer `rocm_generic_attn` for seq>1024 before CPU fallback. Doing that should restore ~1.1x latency vs baseline. Example snippet:
```
conditional_routes:
  - match: { arch: gfx1030, seq_len: { gt: 1024 } }
    prefer_kernels: [rocm_generic_attn, rocm_quant_attn]
    allow_cpu_fallback: true
```

sam: note that enabling `rocm_generic_attn` may increase VRAM usage slightly — watch OOM. Also tweak batching heuristics: reduce `max_batch_delay_ms` for those paths to avoid huge batch buildup.

infra-bot: deploy started: patch/eng-runtime/rocm-routing-hotfix -> staging (ci/tests: 42/42 passing)

taylor: i'll run the repro with the routing patch: `./tools/infer --model redwood-7b --seq 1536 --iters 50` and post perf numbers.

nishant: i'll kick off nightly autotuner run for amd pool and add logging to capture kernel selection reasons (enable ENV `RT_DEBUG_KERNEL_SELECTION=1`).

mia: filed issue #4521 `rocm kernel gap: gfx1030 seq>1024` with reproducer + logs. assigning to eng-runtime, label `rocm-kernel-gap` and `high-prio`.

sam: if the hotfix holds in staging we can ship a conservative canary to 10% of amd nodes tomorrow morning. also need a postmortem doc for why packaging missed those kernels.

taylor: perf after hotfix (staging): 40.1 ms/token — much better. staying on it. :thumbsup:
